title: An R-universal semisimple Lie algebra becomes inner over an imaginary quadratic extension with the prescribed star-action
author: Dave Witte Morris
work: A Cohomological Proof that Real Representations of Semisimple Lie Algebras Have Q-Forms
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 034, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.034; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the structural lemma on the minimal extension over which an R-universal semisimple Lie algebra becomes inner (author lemma at source lines 470-475, label SameFixed). The proof (source lines 477-493) is a two-step argument: it first identifies the minimal extension with the centre of a Tits algebra computed at a weight moved by the Galois action and deduces that it is imaginary quadratic (proof lines 478-485), and then shows that the star-action of Gal(L/Q) agrees with that of Gal(C/R) by reducing an arbitrary invariant weight to the root lattice and invoking the author's fourth description of R-universality (proof lines 486-493). The lemma is what makes condition (2) of the author's direct-sum criterion meaningful, and the proof uses two different earlier statements of the paper rather than a citation. H2.
